profiles.notesEn: Wiki records version/winmm/winhttp for Windows Steam. Select Client/WindowsNoEditor/HT/Binaries/Win64. d3d12 does not enable spoofing. Upstream tested 0.9.5-pre3; this fork's NR is not certified by that report.
profiles.notesZh: Wiki 记录 Windows Steam 版可用 version/winmm/winhttp。请选择 Client/WindowsNoEditor/HT/Binaries/Win64。d3d12 无法启用显卡伪装。上游测试版本为 0.9.5-pre3，此记录不等同于本 fork 的 NR 验证。

profiles.notesEn: The Wiki compatibility list requires d3d12.dll to detect DLSS input. Game-specific NR behavior still requires validation.
